source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: When the [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase) starts, choose one friendly **CANOPTEK** unit up to 3″ from the Macrocytes. For the remainder of the phase, the chosen unit’s models get a 1-point improvement to Weapon Skill.
